coverage: The content index loads byte-identical LOCK 43 V2 data, with the locked town, three people, separate masjid and both missions.
The line 43 Road map requires the Gate of Mercy and takes 100 minutes each way. Map Back returns to the hub.

Nahla starts at trust 10. The hub follows R6 and shows work from 07:00 to 16:00 outside Friday prayer. Each shift takes 60 minutes, earns four coins and adds one local trust on the first shift of the day. The inn costs two coins.
The hillside masjid resolves by id. The first prayer adds one distinct visit and shows its locked line. Back returns to Nahla.
Dawud, Umm Yahya and Ayyub use exact copy at trust 10, 50 and 80. Their own Talk buttons follow the locked hours and Friday prayer availability.

All six endings use exact copy, choice order, coin guards, effects, elapsed minutes, flags, local trust, memories and What Nahla says accounts. The paid donkey choice sets donkey_hired and leaves the grabbed-stick memory hidden.
The donkey mission requires sick_child_done and its own hours. Save and restore preserve both completions, and both actions stay hidden when done. Journal rows follow the loaded chapters under R8.
visual_reference: 22 approved masters at 1920 × 1080. Q15 and R11 use the existing Godot layout. Q29 and R6 replace the nh13–nh14 return label with Back to Nahla. Q29 and LOCK 43 V2 set donkey_hired on nh21; donkey_helped is set by nh20.
